q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT D.SALES_ID FROM (SELECT S.NAME ,S.SALES_ID,O.COM_ID FROM SALESPERSON S INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON S.SALES_ID=O.SALES_ID INNER JOIN COMPANY C ON O.COM_ID=C.COM_ID)D WHERE D.COM_ID IN (SELECT COM_ID FROM COMPANY WHERE NAME LIKE'%RED%'))
